title: Jamie Lee Curtis to Receive Inaugural Award Inspired by Rob and Michele Reiner at Children’s Institute Gala; John Mayer to Perform
summary: Jake and Romy Reiner teamed with their aunt, Martine Singer, president and CEO of Children's Institute, to create in the inaugural award. "Our parents taught us what it means to be good, decent human beings. And they didn't just talk about it; they led by example," said Jake.
